text_en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights!
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请你们在天上赞美上主， 请你们在高处赞美上主！

text_en: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his host!
text_cn: 他的诸位天使，请赞美他， 他的一切军旅，请赞美他！

text_en: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars!
text_cn: 太阳和月亮，请赞美他， 灿烂的诸星，请赞美他！

text_en: Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens!
text_cn: 天上的诸天，请赞美他， 天上的大水，请赞美他！

text_en: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for he commanded and they were created.
text_cn: 愿它们齐来赞美上主的名号！ 因为上主一命，他们立刻受造。

text_en: He established them forever and ever; he fixed their bounds, which cannot be passed.
text_cn: 他确定的位置，留至永恒， 他颁布的规律，永不变更。

text_en: Praise the Lord from the earth, you sea monsters and all deeps,
text_cn: 请你们在地上赞美上主： 海怪和海深处的众水族，

text_en: fire and hail, snow and frost, stormy wind fulfilling his command!
text_cn: 还有电火与冰雹，白雪和云雾， 以及遵行他命令的狂风暴雨。

text_en: Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars!
text_cn: 山岳和一切丘陵， 果树与各种柏松，

text_en: Wild animals and all cattle, creeping things and flying birds!
text_cn: 野兽和一切畜牲， 各种爬虫和鸟类，

text_en: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth!
text_cn: 世上的列王和万民， 地上的元首与公卿，

text_en: Young men and women alike, old and young together!
text_cn: 少年人和童贞女， 老年人与儿童侣，

text_en: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his glory is above earth and heaven.
text_cn: 请你们赞美上主的名字， 因为只有他的名字高贵， 他的尊严远远超越天地，

text_en: He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his faithful, for the people of Israel who are close to him. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 上主使自己百姓的头角高耸， 他是他自己一切圣徒的赞颂， 即接近他的以色列民的光荣。
